2026-11-14 05:44:24.306297 | controller | Also=, or Alias= settings in the [Install] section, and DefaultInstance= for
2026-11-14 05:44:24.306308 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-11-14 05:44:24.306313 | controller |
2026-11-14 05:44:24.306317 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-11-14 05:44:24.306322 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-11-14 05:44:24.306326 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-11-14 05:44:24.306330 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-11-14 05:44:24.306333 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
